**Finding: deviation (INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor)**

- **What the document does:** Article 12 has a mutual indemnity with a full, standard procedure (12.2.1 notice, 12.2.2 control of defence, 12.2.3 participation, 12.2.4 settlement, 12.2.5 cooperation) plus insurance. SFJ's limb (12.1.1) covers its gross negligence/wilful misconduct, material breach of the Agreement, Protocol breaches, AZ License breaches, and post-Program-Transfer trial injury and product liability.
- **The gap:** third-party IP infringement runs one way against us. 12.1.2(f) has PB indemnifying SFJ for infringement "by the Product **or by either Party** in performing its duties or obligations hereunder" — i.e., we absorb SFJ's own infringing conduct (only gross negligence/wilful misconduct or material breach is carved out) — and SFJ gives no IP indemnity at all. That fails the fallback position.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** added an SFJ limb (f) for actual or alleged third-party IP infringement arising from SFJ's, its Affiliates' or Permitted Third Parties' performance (re-lettering the product-liability limb to (g) and updating the "(a) through (g)" tail), and deleted "either Party" from 12.1.2(f) so our indemnity is confined to the Product and our own performance. The rest of PB's operating-party indemnity is untouched as part of the existing bargain.
